items.quote: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him
items.claim: The sons of Aaron brought the blood of the sin offering to the officiant. The text says only 'him'; that this means Aaron comes from the surrounding chapter (Leviticus 9), which is an unverified model-prior reading and is not in the excerpt.
items.mechanism: ritual procedure: passing the blood to the officiant

items.quote: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar
items.claim: The officiant dipped his finger in the blood, put it on the horns of the altar, and poured the rest out at the bottom of the altar.
items.actor: he (the officiant; Aaron by model-prior inference)
items.action: dipped finger in, applied to horns, poured out
items.place: horns and bottom of the altar
items.mechanism: ritual application of blood to the altar

items.quote: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar
items.claim: The officiant burned the fat, the kidneys and the caul above the liver of the sin offering on the altar.
items.actor: he (the officiant; Aaron by model-prior inference)
items.object: the fat, kidneys, and caul above the liver of the sin offering
items.mechanism: burning set-apart parts of the sacrifice

items.claim: The text says this procedure followed a command the LORD gave to Moses.
items.mechanism: divine command given as the authority for the ritual
